zh: 週二美股收高，那斯達克領漲：標普 500 上漲 0.60% 收 7,722.60，那斯達克上漲 1.18% 收 26,477.81，道瓊幾乎持平（+0.03%，收 52,377.57）。盤中上漲家數約為下跌家數的 1.6 至 1.8 倍，11 個板塊有 6 個上漲、科技領先；9 月美國資本財新訂單增加，被解讀為 AI 投資熱潮仍在。恐慌指數 VIX 下降 4.73% 至 17.52。
en: US stocks closed higher on Tuesday with the Nasdaq leading: the S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7,722.60, the Nasdaq gained 1.18% to 26,477.81 and the Dow was nearly flat (+0.03%) at 52,377.57. Midday, advancers outnumbered decliners by roughly 1.6 to 1.8 times, six of 11 sectors rose led by tech, and September orders for US-made capital goods increased, read as a sign the AI spending boom continues. The VIX fell 4.73% to 17.52.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週二 +0.60%
那斯達克 100 ETF，週二那斯達克 +1.18%
道瓊 ETF，週二僅 +0.03%

zh: 個股兩極：波音收跌約 10.7%，起因是執行長 Ortberg 表示 737 的產能目標要到 2027 年初才會達成；博通盤中漲近 4%，因為多家銀行與 Blackstone 為 Anthropic 的 AI 晶片安排融資；特斯拉盤中漲 3.8%，創三個多月高點；Meta 盤中小跌 0.8%，它將史上最大的股權募資規模提高到 975 億美元，輝達、AMD 與博通表達了最多 50 億美元的認購意願。
en: Single stocks split: Boeing closed down about 10.7% after CEO Kelly Ortberg said the 737 production-rate target would not be reached until early 2027. Broadcom rose almost 4% midday as several banks and Blackstone lined up financing for AI chips for Anthropic, and Tesla gained 3.8% to its highest in more than three months. Meta dipped 0.8% after raising its record equity fundraising to $97.5 billion, with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom expressing interest in up to $5 billion.

stocks.n: 波音，收跌約 10.7%，737 產能目標延到 2027 年初
博通，盤中近 +4%，Anthropic AI 晶片融資案
特斯拉，盤中 +3.8%，三個多月新高
Meta，股權募資上調到 975 億美元

zh: WTI 十二月合約約 100.20 美元（+0.30%），布蘭特連兩個交易日回落，但仍接近 4 月下旬以來的高位，能源是 11 個板塊中落後的族群。十年期美債殖利率 4.993%，貼著 5%；黃金 4,073 美元（-0.04%）；比特幣約 8.08 萬美元（+1.18%）。市場眼光放在週三的聯準會決策，利率與油價是這一輪 AI 行情最大的外部變數。
en: WTI December crude was about $100.20 (+0.30%), while Brent slipped for a second straight session but stayed near its highest since late April, and energy lagged among the 11 sectors. The 10-year Treasury yield was 4.993%, hugging 5%; gold was $4,073 (-0.04%) and bitcoin about $80,800 (+1.18%). Attention turns to Wednesday's Fed decision, with rates and oil the biggest outside variables for the AI rally.

stocks.n: 美國原油基金，WTI 約 100 美元
能源類股 ETF，板塊中落後
長天期美債 ETF，十年期殖利率 4.993%
黃金 ETF，約 4,073 美元

zh: 水處理設備商 Xylem 第三季訂單 23.3 億美元（年增 7%，內生 +10%），營收 22.0 億美元（年減 3%，內生持平），調整後每股盈餘 1.44 美元，落在公司自己的 1.42 至 1.47 區間。真正讓股價收跌約 14.2% 的是全年財測：調整後每股盈餘從 5.55 至 5.70 美元降到 5.40 至 5.45 美元，營收由年增 2% 改為年減 1%。公司同時宣布要出售 Applied Water International 與 Specialty Flow Control。
en: Xylem's third-quarter orders were $2.331 billion (+7%, +10% organic) and revenue $2.201 billion (-3%, flat organic), with adjusted EPS of $1.44 inside its own $1.42 to $1.47 range. What sent the shares down about 14.2% was full-year guidance: adjusted EPS cut to $5.40 to $5.45 from $5.55 to $5.70, and revenue now down 1% instead of up 2%. It also said it will divest Applied Water International and Specialty Flow Control.

stocks.n: Xylem，財測下修，收跌約 14.2%
水資源主題 ETF，Xylem 為代表性持股之一（持股比重請自行查證）

zh: SoFi 週二公布第三季：淨營收創高的 14 億美元、淨利 2.41 億美元，會員數 1,710 萬（年增 35%），並把 2026 年調整後淨營收財測上調到約 50.4 億美元、調整後 EBITDA 約 16.6 億美元（Q2 時分別為 47.5 至 48.5 億與約 16 億），首度給出 2027 年展望：調整後淨營收 64 億美元、EBITDA 22.4 億美元、每股盈餘 0.90 美元。股價收漲約 13.4%。同一週，Robinhood 與 Coinbase 也要交成績單。
en: SoFi reported third-quarter record net revenue of $1.4 billion, net income of $241 million and 17.1 million members (+35%). It raised 2026 guidance to about $5.04 billion of adjusted net revenue and $1.66 billion of adjusted EBITDA (from $4.75 to $4.85 billion and about $1.6 billion after Q2) and gave its first 2027 outlook: $6.4 billion of adjusted net revenue, $2.24 billion of EBITDA and $0.90 of EPS. The shares closed up about 13.4%. Robinhood and Coinbase also report this week.

stocks.n: SoFi，上調 2026 財測並給 2027 展望，收漲約 13.4%
Robinhood，本週也公布財報，金融科技同業對照

zh: 聯準會 10 月 27 至 28 日的會議，決策將在週三美東下午 2 點公布，2 點半記者會，這次不附經濟預測（SEP）。市場普遍預期維持利率不變，9 月才以 12 比 0 的票數升息 1 碼到 3.75%–4.00%；焦點在主席 Warsh 對 12 月的說法。各家期貨隱含的 12 月再升息機率落在約 80% 到 84%，來源之間不一致，以 CME FedWatch 為準。
en: The Fed's October 27-28 meeting ends Wednesday with the decision at 2 p.m. ET and a news conference at 2:30 p.m., and this meeting has no Summary of Economic Projections. Markets broadly expect no change after September's 12-0 vote to raise rates a quarter point to 3.75%-4.00%, and the focus is Chair Warsh's language on December. Futures-implied odds of another December hike run from about 80% to 84% depending on the source, so check CME FedWatch.

stocks.n: 短天期美債 ETF，對政策利率預期最敏感
美元指數 ETF，Fed 路徑與美元的觀察點

zh: 通膨是這輪利率故事的底。二手整理指出 9 月 CPI 年增 3.7%（8 月 3.4%），週四要公布的 9 月 PCE 預期 3.6%（前值 3.4%）；加上美伊衝突讓 WTI 維持在 100 美元上下，市場預期到 2027 年中至少還有兩次升息。十年期殖利率 4.993% 逼近 5%，也讓債務融資的 AI 資本支出多了一層利息成本的檢驗。
en: Inflation anchors the rate story. Secondary summaries put September CPI at 3.7% year over year (August 3.4%) and consensus for Thursday's September PCE at 3.6% (previously 3.4%); with the US-Iran conflict keeping WTI near $100, markets price at least two more hikes by mid-2027. A 10-year yield of 4.993%, close to 5%, adds an interest-cost test for debt-funded AI capital spending.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，殖利率貼近 5%
抗通膨公債 ETF，PCE 預期 3.6% 的對照

zh: 晶片股週二上漲約 3.2%，是三連漲，前幾週的重摔暫時被收回；表現最突出的包括 CoreWeave、Nebius、戴爾、美超微與威騰電子，也就是 AI 算力與儲存的鏈條。博通盤中漲近 4%，因為銀行與 Blackstone 為 Anthropic 的晶片安排融資，等於把資金面上的疑慮先解了一半。判讀：這波反彈靠的是融資到位與需求訊號，還沒經過週三、週四的科技財報檢驗。
en: Chip stocks rose about 3.2% on Tuesday, a third straight daily gain that recovered part of the past few weeks' rout, with CoreWeave, Nebius, Dell, Super Micro and Western Digital among the best performers, the AI compute and storage chain. Broadcom gained almost 4% as banks and Blackstone lined up financing for Anthropic's chips, easing part of the funding worry. The rebound rests on financing and demand signals and has not yet faced Wednesday and Thursday's tech earnings.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，晶片股週二約 +3.2%
博通，Anthropic 晶片融資案
CoreWeave，週二表現最佳之一
Nebius，AI 雲端算力
戴爾，AI 伺服器鏈

zh: 工業與資本財出現兩種聲音：9 月美國資本財新訂單增加，支持 AI 相關投資持續；但個別公司被重罰，波音因 737 產能延到 2027 年初收跌約 10.7%，Xylem 因下修財測收跌約 14.2%。通用汽車盤中大漲 6.3%，宣布要把上市地轉到那斯達克。這類行情說明：產業數據好看，不代表每家公司的財測都跟得上。
en: Industrials sent two messages: September orders for US-made capital goods rose, supporting ongoing AI-related investment, while individual names were punished, with Boeing down about 10.7% on a 737 production delay to early 2027 and Xylem down about 14.2% on a guidance cut. General Motors jumped 6.3% midday on plans to move its listing to Nasdaq. Healthy sector data does not mean every company's guidance keeps up.

stocks.n: 工業類股 ETF，資本財訂單與個股分歧並存
波音，737 產能延後
通用汽車，轉到那斯達克上市，盤中 +6.3%

zh: 能源是週二唯一明顯落後的主要板塊：布蘭特連兩個交易日回落，WTI 約 100 美元，雖然仍接近 4 月下旬以來的高位，但交易員在週三 Fed 之前降低了對衝擊的押注。能源與科技的拉鋸，反映市場目前把「油價推升通膨、迫使聯準會再升息」視為最大風險；油價續降，對利率敏感的成長股較有利，續升則相反。
en: Energy was the one major sector that clearly lagged on Tuesday: Brent fell for a second straight session and WTI sat near $100, still close to its highest since late April, as traders reduced shock bets before Wednesday's Fed. The energy-versus-tech tug of war reflects the market's biggest worry, that oil lifts inflation and forces the Fed to hike again; lower oil helps rate-sensitive growth stocks and higher oil does the opposite.

stocks.n: 能源類股 ETF，週二板塊中落後
美國原油基金，WTI 約 100 美元

zh: 羅素 2000 週二上漲 1.16% 收 2,818.87，比標普 500 的 0.60% 強一倍，前一天是 2,786.42。小型股的優勢往往來自風險偏好回升，但它對利率的敏感度也更高：許多公司靠浮動利率借款，十年期殖利率貼近 5% 時，利息負擔會直接吃掉獲利。明天 Fed 的措辭如果偏鷹，小型股的反應通常比大型股更大。
en: The Russell 2000 gained 1.16% to 2,818.87 on Tuesday, about twice the S&P 500's 0.60%, after closing at 2,786.42 the day before. Small caps often win when risk appetite improves but are also more rate-sensitive: many rely on floating-rate borrowing, so with the 10-year near 5% interest costs can eat directly into profits. A hawkish tone from the Fed on Wednesday would typically hit small caps harder than large caps.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，週二指數 +1.16%
標普小型 600 ETF，品質較高的小型股對照

zh: Bank of Marin（BMRC）10/26 公布第三季：淨利 990 萬美元（EPS 0.62，去年同期 0.47），淨息差 3.48%，比上季 3.38% 再升 10 個基點、去年同期是 2.97%；存款成本由 1.28% 降到 1.24%，無息存款占 37.8%。但分類貸款從 1,990 萬升到 3,500 萬美元（占貸款 1.63%），主因是一筆 1,410 萬美元的自用商用不動產被降級，公司說借款人準時還款、預期無損失；每股淨值因證券未實現損失降 1.14 美元到 23.37 美元。獲利改善是真的，但風險欄也在動，值得追到下一季。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Bank of Marin (BMRC) reported Q3 on 10/26: net income $9.9 million (EPS $0.62 vs $0.47 a year ago), net interest margin 3.48%, up 10 basis points from 3.38% last quarter and 2.97% a year earlier, with deposit cost down to 1.24% and noninterest-bearing deposits 37.8% of the total. But classified loans rose from $19.9 million to $35.0 million (1.63% of loans), mainly one $14.1 million owner-occupied CRE relationship downgraded (the bank says the borrower is current and no loss is expected), and book value per share fell $1.14 to $23.37 on unrealized securities losses. Earnings improvement is real but the risk line is also moving. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Bank of Marin，淨息差 3.48%，分類貸款升到 1.63%
區域銀行 ETF，社區銀行情緒的對照

zh: MSG Sports 把紐約遊騎兵（Rangers）分拆出來：股權登記日 10/20，每 2 股 MSG Sports 換 1 股 MSG Rangers（MSGR），母公司改名 MSG Knickerbockers（MSGK），只留尼克隊；依公司公告，正式交易（regular way）排定 10/27 開始。分拆股的常見現象是原股東不想要新持股，首週容易出現被動賣壓，這是潛在的錯價來源，也可能只是持續下探。本輪沒查到首日價格，需先看實際成交與獨立後的債務、營運成本。研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: MSG Sports is spinning off the New York Rangers: record date 10/20, one MSG Rangers (MSGR) share for every two MSG Sports shares, with the parent renamed MSG Knickerbockers (MSGK) and keeping only the Knicks; per the company's announcement regular-way trading was scheduled to begin 10/27. Spin-offs often see passive selling from holders who do not want the new stock in the first weeks, a possible source of mispricing but also of further downside. I did not find first-day prices, so actual trading and the standalone debt and cost structure come first. A research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: MSG Rangers，分拆新股，排定 10/27 正式交易
MSG Knickerbockers，原 MSG Sports 更名，保留尼克隊

en: Parke Bancorp (PKBK), a New Jersey community bank, reported Q3 on 10/21: net income $12.2 million (+14.5%), net interest income $23.0 million (+14.2%), revenue $39.6 million (+6.1%) and diluted EPS about $1.02, with nine-month net income to common up 35.9% to $36.2 million. The credit-loss provision was $1.0 million (vs $0.4 million) and total assets $2.33 billion. Earnings momentum is strong, but I did not retrieve the net interest margin or non-performing loan ratio, which decide growth quality and need the full release. A research lead, not investment advice.

Three benchmarks: Q1 2026 tax-equivalent net interest margin of 3.77% (3.41% a year earlier) and 3.50% in Q3 2025. zh: 第三方整理（Brimind，10/14 更新）顯示 H.B. Fuller（FUL）有 3 位內部人在公開市場買進，合計 12,465 股、均價約 49.92 美元，最近一筆在 10/7，其中最大買家是董事、增持幅度很大。但另一個資料站列出的買進人、日期與股數都不同（例如 9/29 至 9/30 的買進），兩邊對不起來。結論：FUL 是候選名單，不是定論，必須回 SEC EDGAR 查 Form 4 的買進者、金額與日期再判斷。

Fuller (FUL) insiders buying on the open market, 12,465 shares in total at an average of about $49.92, the latest on 10/7, with a director the largest buyer by stake increase. Another data site lists different buyers, dates and share counts, such as purchases on 9/29 and 9/30, so the two do not reconcile. FUL is a candidate, not a conclusion: check the Form 4s on SEC EDGAR for buyers, amounts and dates.

stocks.n: H.B. Fuller，第三方資料顯示 3 位內部人買進，來源不一致

zh: 「群聚買進」通常指 3 位以上內部人在同一段時間公開市場買進。判讀時有兩個提醒：一是人數要和金額一起看，有些群聚每人只買幾千美元，象徵意義大於資金意義；二是資料站自己打的「可信度分數」是各家私有演算法，不是驗證。真正的依據只有 EDGAR 上的 Form 4。另外，內部人買進只說明他們願意在這個價位加碼，不保證股價會反應。
en: A cluster buy usually means three or more insiders buying on the open market within a window. Two cautions: weigh headcount together with dollar size, since some clusters are a few thousand dollars each and symbolic more than financial, and treat data sites' credibility scores as proprietary, not validation. The only real record is the Form 4 on EDGAR. And insider buying shows willingness to add at that price, not a guarantee the stock will react.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，內部人買進線索多集中在小型股

zh: 本期沒有找到「部位有明確主題」的政要申報，所以只寫判讀。最近公開的幾筆例子都很小：例如眾議員 David Taylor 買進 AT&T（交易日 10/9），金額落在 3,003 至 45,000 美元；Cleo Fields 買進 Alphabet 類股（交易日 9/14，10/1 揭露），金額 5,005 至 75,000 美元。STOCK Act 只要求披露金額區間，上下限差到十幾倍，再加上最多 45 天的申報延遲，讀者看到時價格早已變動。這些資訊適合看興趣，不適合當買賣訊號。
en: No disclosure with a clear thesis this period, so only interpretation. The recent examples are small: Rep. David Taylor bought AT&T (trade date 10/9) in the $3,003 to $45,000 range, and Cleo Fields bought Alphabet stock (trade 9/14, disclosed 10/1) in the $5,005 to $75,000 range. The STOCK Act requires only value ranges, with upper bounds more than ten times the lower, plus up to 45 days of filing delay, so prices have moved by the time anyone reads them. Good for curiosity, not for trading signals.

stocks.n: AT&T，Taylor 申報買進 3,003 至 45,000 美元
Alphabet C 股，Fields 申報買進 5,005 至 75,000 美元

tag: 週三 Fed 週四 GDP
zh: 未來 5 個交易日的總經重點：週三美東下午 2 點聯準會決策（無 SEP），2 點半記者會；週四早上 8:30 同時公布第三季 GDP 初值（預期約 3.0% 至 3.2%，來源不一）與 9 月 PCE（整體預期 3.6%，前值 3.4%）；下週五才是 10 月就業報告，11/3 是美國期中選舉。決策與通膨數字連續兩天落地，波動可能集中在週三、週四。
en: Macro for the next five trading days: the Fed decision at 2 p.m. ET Wednesday (no SEP) and a press conference at 2:30; Thursday at 8:30 a.m. advance Q3 GDP (expected about 3.0% to 3.2%, sources differ) and September PCE (headline consensus 3.6% vs 3.4% prior); the October jobs report is not until next Friday, and US midterms are on 11/3. With the decision and inflation data landing on back-to-back days, volatility may cluster Wednesday and Thursday.

stocks.n: 美元指數 ETF，Fed 與 PCE 的反應指標
抗通膨公債 ETF，PCE 預期 3.6%

zh: 重點財報：週三盤後微軟與 Alphabet，週四亞馬遜；另有來源列出週三還有 ServiceNow、T-Mobile 與福特。市場最關心 AI 資本支出與雲端成長，上一季的雲端營收成長，據週報整理為 Azure 43.0%、Google Cloud 82.0%、AWS 36.7%。蘋果這週辦的是新品活動，而不是財報。另外 Coinbase、Robinhood 與 Strategy 也在這週公布。
en: Key earnings: Microsoft and Alphabet after the close Wednesday, Amazon Thursday; one source also lists ServiceNow, T-Mobile and Ford on Wednesday. The market focuses on AI capital spending and cloud growth, with last quarter's cloud growth reported in a weekly preview as Azure 43.0%, Google Cloud 82.0% and AWS 36.7%. Apple holds a product event this week, not earnings, and Coinbase, Robinhood and Strategy also report.

zh: 把今天放在一起：那斯達克 +1.18%、羅素 2000 +1.16%，風險偏好明顯回來；但同一天，十年期殖利率貼著 5%、聯準會剛在 9 月升息、明天要決策，而且波音（-10.7%）與 Xylem（-14.2%）都因財測或產能延後被重罰。市場願意獎勵好消息（SoFi +13.4%），也毫不留情處罰壞消息。明天微軟與 Alphabet 的資本支出數字，會和 Fed 的措辭一起決定這波反彈能不能延續。
en: Put today together: the Nasdaq rose 1.18% and the Russell 2000 1.16%, so risk appetite is back; yet the 10-year yield sits near 5%, the Fed hiked in September and decides tomorrow, and Boeing (-10.7%) and Xylem (-14.2%) were punished for guidance or production delays. The market rewards good news (SoFi +13.4%) and punishes bad news without mercy. Tomorrow's capital-spending figures from Microsoft and Alphabet, together with the Fed's wording, will decide whether the rebound lasts.
